tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Find events where Gisela Torres is scheduled to participate or has participated. Use it when a visitor asks where or when Gisela will speak, attend, or take part in an event. Returns matching event names, dates, locations, summaries, event pages, and external information links.

query.description: Optional topic, event name, or location.

timeframe.description: Whether to return upcoming, past, or all events.

tools.name: get_social_profiles
tools.description: Get Gisela Torres's official social media and creator profiles. Use it when a visitor wants to follow, contact, or find Gisela on another platform. Returns the official GitHub, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook profile names and URLs.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search returngis.net using the visible site search form. Use it when the visitor wants to navigate to the site search results for a topic. Opens the WordPress search results page.

tools.name: search_youtube_videos
tools.description: Search videos published on Gisela Torres's YouTube channel by topic or keywords. Use it when a visitor wants a video explanation, tutorial, demo, or presentation from Gisela. Returns matching video titles, descriptions, publication dates, thumbnails, and YouTube URLs.

query.description: The topic or keywords to search for.
